maria_sec: FYI — I just reproduced an access escalation during the RBAC refactor (rbac_v2). Delegated role entries with the same role name as a parent role are being treated as equivalent, so a delegated 'reader' is getting parent scope secrets. Repro below, quick logs attached. :eyes:

maria_sec: Repro steps:
1) create role 'team-a:reader' on account A
2) delegate 'team-reader' (name collision: 'reader') to service account B via new API
3) request secret with svc-account B token -> 200 (should be 403)

Logs snippet:
```
2026-02-12T10:02:31Z auth: token=svc-B, evaluated_roles=[reader, team-a:reader], allowed_by=role_match(name)
2026-02-12T10:02:31Z rbac: matched role_name=reader -> granted secrets:team-a/*
```

maria_sec: Immediate concern: if we roll the current rbac_v2 change, some existing delegations could accidentally escalate. I created a vuln ticket: VULN-2026-843.

secbot: Created VULN ticket VULN-2026-843 and added priority=high. :lock:

ajay_ops: Can you attach the audit log entry (full) and the role record JSON? Need to know if we compare by display_name or role_id. Also does this touch KMS key ACLs or only service-level secrets?

maria_sec: audit snippets attached (pasted below). We compare role.name in the API layer (display name). DB still has role_id but the refactor introduced a lookup that normalizes names and doesn't namespace them. KMS keys unaffected directly, but secret access check runs before KMS decrypt; so this is a gating bug.

kelly_docs: We should block the rbac_v2 rollout and ship a short SDK patch that treats role identifiers as opaque IDs. Also add a migration safety check that rejects colliding role display names. Docs TODO: note behavioral change, add migration guide and example SDK patch.

ajay_ops: Agreed — block. For mitigation, we can add a runtime guard: if delegated_role.namespace != resource.namespace -> reject until we patch. Quick WAF-like rule. Anyone able to push that as a hotfix?

maria_sec: I'll open a hotfix branch now. Plan: 1) reject delegation on name collision (short-term) 2) patch auth evaluator to use role_id equality 3) add unit + integration tests + audit event field role_source="explicit_id" 4) update SDK to accept role_id param and warn on deprecated name param.

dante_infra: For the patch, prefer DB-safe change: add `effective_role_key` that is the concatenation of role_id and namespace and use it in evaluator. Avoid large migrations at deploy. I'll PR the schema change and evaluator change. ETA end of day for PR.

sre_oncall: If we block rollout, what's the impact to infra? Will we need to rollback running hosts or just gate the feature flag?

maria_sec: Gate the feature flag for rbac_v2 globally for now. No rollback needed. We'll flip flag after guard + tests.

kelly_docs: I'll draft the internal KB and an SDK changelog entry. Also prepare a short customer-facing blurb for tenants with delegated roles to run the migration check.

ajay_ops: Assigning tasks: maria_sec -> hotfix/eval patch + vuln ticket owner; dante_infra -> DB/eval PR; kelly_docs -> docs + SDK note; me (ajay_ops) -> enable global feature flag off and monitor.

secbot: VULN-2026-843 updated: assignees=[maria_sec, dante_infra, kelly_docs, ajay_ops]. Severity=high.

maria_sec: Quick mitigation steps for SREs: 1) run `select id,name,namespace from roles where name ilike '%reader%'` and look for duplicates across namespaces, 2) temporarily revoke delegated bindings that match on name (script below).

maria_sec: Revoke script (quick):
```
# list delegations that shadow
psql -c "select d.id, d.role_name, r.namespace from delegations d join roles r on r.name=d.role_name where r.namespace!=d.namespace;"
# revoke
psql -c "delete from delegations where id in (<list>)"
```

dante_infra: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/rbac/pull/1224 — changes evaluator to use role_id, adds effective_role_key. CI added.

kelly_docs: Drafted KB: https://confluence.internal/redwood/display/Security/RBAC+Name+Collision+Mitigation (internal). Also added SDK snippet to warn on name param.

ajay_ops: Feature flag toggled off across regions at 2026-02-12T14:20Z. Monitoring logs for auth 403 spikes.

maria_sec: Patch merged to release branch, hotfix build in progress. Will attach release ID and changelog when done.

sre_oncall: Noted. If we see any unexpected 403s post-mitigation, we'll roll back the revocations and open a follow-up.

maria_sec: Final: hotfix deployed to prod at 2026-02-12T16:03Z, release rbac-hotfix-20260212. Audit events now include role_id and role_source. Please prioritize running the migration check in the morning. Thanks all :thumbsup:
